title: Appyters: Turning Jupyter Notebooks into data-driven web apps
paper_title: Appyters: Turning Jupyter Notebooks into data-driven web apps
description: This paper introduces Appyters, a framework that turns Jupyter Notebooks into easy-to-use web applications for data analysis. The authors show how Appyters help biologists upload data, choose options, and receive reproducible reports without needing to write code.

title: sc2DAT: Workflow for Targeting Tumor Subpopulations of Single Cells
paper_title: sc2DAT: Workflow for Targeting Tumor Subpopulations of Single Cells
description: Axiom and Trinity explore sc2DAT — a web-based workflow that integrates single-cell and bulk RNA-seq data to identify cell-type-specific therapeutic targets and compounds for precision cancer treatment.

title: MultiOmics2Targets: Personalized Cancer Target Identification
paper_title: Multiomics2Targets identifies targets from cancer cohorts profiled with transcriptomics, proteomics, and phosphoproteomics
description: Axiom and Trinity explore MultiOmics2Targets — a platform for integrative analysis of transcriptomics, proteomics, and phosphoproteomics data to identify and prioritize therapeutic targets from cancer patient cohorts.

title: Harmonizome 3.0: Unified Gene and Protein Knowledge
paper_title: Harmonizome 3.0: integrated knowledge about genes and proteins from diverse multi-omics resources
description: Axiom and Trinity break down Harmonizome 3.0 — a major upgrade to the Harmonizome database that integrates nearly 12 million gene-attribute associations from diverse omics resources, with new AI-ready formats and LLM-powered dataset comparisons.

title: RummaGEO: Mining Gene Sets from GEO at Scale
paper_title: RummaGEO: Automatic Mining of Human and Mouse Gene Sets from GEO
description: Axiom and Trinity explore RummaGEO — a search engine that automatically mines over 293,000 human and mouse gene sets from RNA-seq studies in GEO, enabling global gene expression signature search across tens of thousands of studies.

title: Rummagene: Surfacing Buried Gene Sets from Publications
paper_title: Rummagene: massive mining of gene sets from supporting materials of biomedical research publications
description: Axiom and Trinity explore Rummagene — a server that crawls PubMed Central to extract and serve hundreds of thousands of gene sets buried in supplementary materials, enabling enrichment analysis and gene function prediction at massive scale.

title: Playbook Workflow Builder: Bioinformatics Without Code
paper_title: Playbook Workflow Builder: Interactive Construction of Bioinformatics Workflows
description: Axiom and Trinity explore the Playbook Workflow Builder (PWB) — a web-based platform for dynamically constructing and executing bioinformatics workflows without programming expertise.

title: ChEA-KG: Transcription Factor Regulatory Networks
paper_title: ChEA-KG: Human Transcription Factor Regulatory Network with a Knowledge Graph Interactive User Interface
description: Axiom and Trinity break down ChEA-KG — a knowledge graph-based resource for exploring human transcription factor regulatory networks through an interactive user interface.

title: GSFM: Gene Set Feature Matrix
paper_title: GPT-based Gene Set Feature Matrix for biological pathway analysis
description: Axiom and Trinity explore GSFM — a GPT-powered approach to encoding gene sets as feature matrices for downstream machine learning in pathway analysis.
